title: Oracle Apps DBA Online Training
description:
About Apps DBA

Oracle Applications DBA tasks (Oracle Financials, Oracle eBusiness Suite) is a complex framework of modules that performs basic business administration and the Oracle Applications DBA must have a fundamental understanding of the business processes.  Oracle Applications DBA requires specialized skills in business administration and Oracle application server architectures. Oracle Applications DBA must also have skills in the areas of Database Design, Oracle Application Server and Functional Expertise.

Prerequisites For Learning Oracle Apps DBA Online Training

  • Graduates/Post Graduates are eligible.
  • Basic skills in business administration.
  • Knowledge on Oracle application server architectures.

Terms And Conditions

  • We will Provide Supporting to resolve Student practical Issues.
  • We will provide server Access and 100% Lab Facility.
  • Resume Preparation.
  • Interview Questions & Answers.
  • We will conduct mock interviews. Student also gets 100% supporting before and after getting job.
